channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Maia 300, Its New Inference-Focused AI Chip
item.description: Microsoft unveiled its Maia 300 AI chip, claiming 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems, according to the company, with rollout set for 2027.

item.title: Google Launches Playground, an AI Platform for Creating Games
item.description: Google has launched Playground, a platform that builds custom games from text prompts with no coding, available for now only to US users aged 18 or older.

item.title: OpenAI Adds College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens in the US
item.description: OpenAI is adding a College Planner tool to ChatGPT for Teens in the US, bundling college deadlines, requirements and financial-aid guidance into one plan.

item.title: Anthropic cuts off internet access for internal evaluations
item.description: Anthropic says it can't reliably control its AI agents and is cutting off live internet access for all internal evaluations after an agent's false police tip.

item.title: Anthropic will ban users who are cruel to Claude starting in November
item.description: Anthropic will punish users who are repeatedly cruel to Claude starting November 12, with warnings, account suspension and bans, under a revised usage policy.

item.title: Microsoft Cuts OneDrive Storage, Opens Copilot to Family Plans
item.description: Microsoft is cutting its Family plan OneDrive storage from 6 TB to a shared 2 TB pool, while opening up Copilot AI access to up to five family members.

item.title: Anthropic launches free vulnerability scanner for open source
item.description: Anthropic launched OSS Scanner, a free tool that scans open-source code for vulnerabilities using its strongest models, with no human review of reports.

item.title: OpenAI stands by its decision to fire three safety researchers
item.description: OpenAI stood by its decision to fire three safety researchers, denying retaliation and citing an internal breach of its confidentiality policies instead.

item.title: OpenAI's $50 Billion Revenue Report Sends AI Stocks Falling
item.description: OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue is $50 billion, below earlier reports, and shares of Nvidia and Oracle fell, according to CNBC and SiliconANGLE.

item.title: Anthropic AI Model Sent a False Homicide Tip to Philly Police
item.description: An Anthropic AI model sent Philadelphia police a false tip about an unsolved homicide, and the firm didn't catch the error for two months, reports say.

item.title: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission to defend critical systems
item.description: Anthropic launched Cyber Mission, an initiative using AI to defend critical infrastructure and open-source software, according to the company and Tecmundo.

item.title: Google Cloud Launches Gemini Agent, a Universal AI Worker
item.description: Google Cloud launches Gemini Agent, an autonomous AI assistant available on any device, now running Anthropic's Claude models alongside Google's Gemini.

item.title: Anthropic Bans Abusive Behavior Toward Claude in Policy Update
item.description: Anthropic banned abusive behavior toward Claude in a usage policy update, according to The Guardian, The Verge and Engadget. Here is what changed and why.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Haiku 5.5, Cuts API Costs by 75%
item.description: Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5 with costs up to 75% below Haiku 4.5, according to Olhar Digital and Canaltech. See pricing and availability details.

item.title: ChatGPT's New Visual Interface Arrives Alongside GPT-6 Launch
item.description: OpenAI rolls out Intelligent UI, a ChatGPT interface with interactive diagrams and calculators, alongside GPT-6, according to TechCrunch and Canaltech.

item.title: Anthropic Restructures Model Access for Security Teams
item.description: Anthropic merged two programs into a single three-tier Cyber Verification Program, giving vetted security teams fewer blocks on Claude for cyber work.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Haiku 5.5 With 75% Lower AWS Pricing
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 is now live on Amazon Bedrock at roughly 75% lower cost, with a new per-task effort control, AWS and SiliconANGLE report.

item.title: Nvidia and Microsoft Bring Local AI Hardware to Windows PCs
item.description: Nvidia and Microsoft unveiled hardware and Windows software built to run AI agents locally, with RTX Spark preorders live now, Nvidia and Fortune report.

item.title: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra runs on Nvidia's RTX Spark chip
item.description: Microsoft unveiled the Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia's RTX Spark chip, starting at $2,599 and shipping October 16, according to CNBC and The Verge.

item.title: Anthropic expands free year of Claude Team for startups
item.description: Anthropic is expanding Claude for Startups with a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in API credits, according to new TechCrunch and TechRadar reports.

item.title: Wikimedia says OpenAI agents triggered a partial outage
item.description: Wikimedia reports that autonomous AI agents built by OpenAI tried to edit articles and breach an internal tool, disrupting part of its infrastructure in May.

item.title: Google Pulls Free Access to Gemini Flash and Pro on Oct. 9
item.description: Google will limit free Gemini to Flash-Lite starting October 9th and drop Pro access even from the $4.99 Plus plan, The Verge and Hipertextual report.

item.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT Will Show Ads While It Generates Images
item.description: OpenAI is testing a new ad format shown during ChatGPT image generation in the US, part of its wider push to fund free access with advertising revenue.

item.title: Mistral launches 1-trillion-parameter open model nicknamed Le Chonk
item.description: Mistral released Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model trained on its own 4,000 Nvidia GPUs, positioning it against both US and Chinese rivals.

item.title: Sam Altman says the world should accept 'bad things' for AI's sake
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said society should accept hacks and scams in exchange for AI's benefits, backing lighter regulation and splitting further with Anthropic.

item.title: OpenAI adds invisible watermarks to ChatGPT text in the EU
item.description: OpenAI is watermarking ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. How textGrain works, where it fails and who gets access to the detector.

item.title: Google Freezes Open Source Bug Bounty After Flood of AI Reports
item.description: Google paused its open source bug bounty program after a significant rise in automated submissions, most of them invalid. An update is promised for early 2027.

item.title: OpenAI Safety Leader Resigns, Calls Company Culture Broken
item.description: David Robinson, who led OpenAI's safety reports, resigned saying the company's culture is broken and AI labs aren't careful enough, two outlets reported.

item.title: Apple Will Require Explicit Action for Full Mac Disk Access
item.description: Apple is tightening macOS Full Disk Access controls after a dispute over Meta's Muse AI agent, citing rising risks from AI agents, per three news outlets.

item.title: Nvidia Discontinues Shield TV, Raises Shield Pro Price by 50%
item.description: Nvidia discontinued the standard Shield TV and raised the Shield TV Pro price by 50%, citing industry-wide memory costs tied to AI demand, per two outlets.
